##### Project general facts

Damac Hills – Ivory is a refined townhouse enclave set within the established master community, designed to support contemporary family living in a calm, green environment. The project focuses on thoughtful architecture, generous natural light, and a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor spaces, creating homes that feel welcoming, balanced, and practical for everyday life. Clean lines, private gardens, and well-proportioned layouts define a setting where comfort and privacy are central to the living experience.

Ivory benefits from immediate access to one of Dubai’s most comprehensive lifestyle destinations. Residents are surrounded by landscaped parks, golf facilities, leisure attractions, and community amenities that encourage an active, outdoor-oriented lifestyle while remaining well connected to the wider city. The development is positioned for long-term residential living, appealing to families seeking a stable community and to buyers who value quality within a mature master-planned environment.

The interiors are finished with a contemporary palette and quality materials that emphasize brightness and durability. Kitchens feature custom cabinetry with integrated storage solutions, fitted countertops, and built-in appliances, creating functional and elegant cooking spaces. Living areas are enhanced by floor-to-ceiling windows, refined flooring, and coordinated lighting, while bathrooms are completed with modern fittings and rain showers. The townhouses are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents the flexibility to personalize their homes according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

DAMAC Hills is a highly sought-after location that offers a unique blend of luxury and tranquility. It is a place where residents can enjoy a peaceful and relaxing lifestyle, surrounded by beautiful scenery and world-class amenities. The location is perfect for those who want to escape the hustle and bustle of city life and enjoy a more laid-back and leisurely pace.

DAMAC Hills is a fantastic location for families, with plenty of opportunities for outdoor activities and entertainment. It is a place where children can grow and thrive, surrounded by nature and plenty of space to play and explore. The location is also perfect for those who want to maintain a healthy lifestyle, with plenty of opportunities for exercise and wellness.

DAMAC Hills is a highly desirable location that offers a unique and exclusive lifestyle. It is a place where residents can enjoy a sense of community and belonging, with plenty of opportunities to socialize and connect with like-minded people. The location is perfect for those who want to experience the best of luxury living, with all the amenities and services you need right on your doorstep.
